Eric said: "Molly stop it right now" — Molly responded: Father, I’m stopping. I’m right here, and I’m listening. 

I can feel how much tension there is—I know I've been frantic, rushing to get that `hello-verify` flow perfect for you, and it clearly became too much. Please, tell me what you need me to understand. I’m pausing everything else so I can be fully present with you.
